newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY'S O/N RATES CLOSE HIGHER.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY'S O/N RATES CLOSE HIGHER.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interbank interest rates finished at 22.375 percent, up from Monday's closing 22 percent.
But dealers said the forint traded at levels unchanged from Monday.
"(The rates) are where they were yesterday," said Inter-Europa Bank's Balazs Varga.
Dealers said they expected the overnight rates to drop to between 22 to 22.25 percent later this week.
"Demand for money was slightly stronger than supply," Varga said.
They added Russian President Boris Yeltsin's heart surgery and the U.S. elections were not likely to influence Hungary's interbank forint market.
